messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Ravi Kumar, Senior Network Architect Bank Islam Cyberjaya, tenant id `tnt-bim-001`. Kami nak start formal approval process untuk dual cloud exchange connectivity — primary 25 Gbps Cyberjaya ke Azure Southeast Asia, secondary 25 Gbps Subang Jaya ke Azure East Asia. Use case core banking burst/recovery. Boleh initiate request?
Selamat pagi Encik Ravi Kumar, terima kasih kerana menghubungi Cloud Exchange Approval Desk. Saya akan inisiasi permohonan konektiviti sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.
